title: Home
text:
I analyse, clean, and visualise data to identify patterns, assess performance, and communicate findings through reports and dashboards.



I apply statistical methods to research questions, investigate relationships between variables, and interpret quantitative evidence.



I support evidence-based programme assessment through data quality checks, descriptive analysis, indicator tracking, and clear reporting.



I use programming, exploratory analysis, and predictive modelling techniques to investigate datasets and develop analytical solutions.

title: Projects
text:
This portfolio presents practical applications of data analysis, statistics, research, and visualisation. Each case study will explain the problem, the data, the methods used, the findings, and their practical implications.


Focus: Electoral data analysis and visualisation.
Repository: View the project on GitHub
This project provides a starting point for demonstrating how electoral registration data can support descriptive analysis and evidence-based interpretation.
The published case study will document the dataset, analytical methods, key findings, and limitations after the repository has been reviewed.



Focus: Statistical testing, relationships between variables, and interpretation.
A case study will be added with a clearly defined research question, appropriate statistical methods, diagnostic checks where necessary, and an interpretation of the results.



Focus: Dashboards, reporting, and decision support.
A case study will demonstrate how data preparation and visualisation can help users monitor performance and identify meaningful patterns.




My approach begins with a clearly defined question. I examine the quality and structure of the data, select methods appropriate to the question, document the analysis, and communicate findings alongside their limitations.

title: About
text:
I have a Bachelor of Science in Statistics and an interest in using quantitative methods to solve practical problems. My work and professional interests span data analytics, statistical research, business intelligence, and monitoring and evaluation.
I am interested in how organisations can use reliable data to understand performance, assess programme outcomes, identify patterns, and make informed decisions.


My professional interests include statistical analysis, data quality, research methods, data visualisation, business intelligence, forecasting, and evidence-based programme assessment.



My analytical toolkit includes SQL, Python, R, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, and statistical software. My level of proficiency varies by tool and task, and I continue to develop these skills through practical projects.



I value transparent analytical methods, reproducible work, clear communication, and conclusions that reflect what the data can actually support.



Visit my GitHub profile to explore my public repositories and analytical projects.
